color.$description: The palette, from the brand book (2026-10-23, pages 13-15) and redesign/brand/paleta.html. Every colour lives on a scale; the brand colours point at the step they are.

brand.$description: The six colours read off the logo

sand.$description: Nisip. The light background: the paper of the ledger

plum.$description: Prună. The main colour on light: buttons, headings, brand bands, the footer

bronze.$description: Bronz. The accent on light grounds and the chart bars. Graphics or text above 24px only on Nisip (3.0:1)

lavender.$description: Liliac. The main colour on dark grounds. Never text on Nisip (1.6:1)

gold.$description: Aur. The accent on Prună and Grafit; large figures

graphite.$description: Grafit. The base of the dark scale and the text on Liliac; dark grounds use steps 600-800

plum.$description: Prună. 300 is Liliac, 800 is Prună from the logo

900.$description: Prună noapte: hover, deep bands, the footer

bronze.$description: Bronz și Aur. 400 is Aur, 600 is Bronz from the logo

800.$description: Bronz text: bronze for small text

neutral.$description: Nisip și Grafit. 100 is Nisip, 900 is Grafit
